structure.custodian: Regulated third-party custodians (incl. InCore Bank AG, Switzerland)
structure.jurisdiction: Jersey issuer under Swiss DLT Act framework; EU prospectus-exempt tracker certificates
structure.redemption: Qualified/professional investors redeem via Backed at NAV; retail exits via secondary DEX/CEX markets. T+2-style settlement against the underlying.
structure.geoRestrictions: Not offered to US persons; additional exclusions incl. UK retail and sanctioned jurisdictions.
structure.notes: Distributed on Solana first (Kraken, Bybit, DEXs), expanding multichain. Tracker certificate, not a share: no voting rights.

structure.custodian: US regulated broker-dealer custody for underlying shares
structure.jurisdiction: Non-US distribution; underlying held in US market structure
structure.redemption: Mint/redeem against underlying via Ondo GM for eligible non-US users; instant on-chain secondary liquidity otherwise.
structure.geoRestrictions: US persons excluded; onboarding subject to KYC and jurisdiction screening.
structure.notes: Tokens follow the TICKERon convention (e.g. AAPLon). Launched 2025 with 100+ tokenized US stocks and ETFs.

structure.legalEntity: Backed Assets (JE) Limited (issuer); distributed via Binance
structure.jurisdiction: Jersey / Switzerland issuance; Binance distribution terms apply
structure.redemption: Primary redemption restricted to qualified participants; secondary liquidity on BNB Chain venues.
structure.geoRestrictions: Not offered to US persons; Binance-level jurisdiction restrictions apply.
structure.notes: BNB Chain distribution of the Backed program.

structure.legalEntity: Dinari, Inc. (US); dShares issued by Dinari securities entities
structure.custodian: US brokerage custody of underlying shares
structure.jurisdiction: US framework; FINRA broker-dealer subsidiary, SEC transfer-agent registration
structure.redemption: Mint/redeem at market via Dinari platform during US market hours; off-hours orders queued.
structure.geoRestrictions: Historically non-US retail; US expansion pending broker-dealer approvals.
structure.notes: dShares (TICKER.d) on Arbitrum, Base and other EVM chains. Dividends passed through to holders.

structure.custodian: Underlying exposure held via US institutional counterparties
structure.redemption: Closed-loop: buy/sell only inside the Robinhood app; tokens not freely transferable on-chain yet.
structure.notes: Derivative-wrapped stock tokens on Arbitrum (migrating to Robinhood Chain). Included for market-share tracking; limited on-chain data while closed-loop.
